content: Daily and monthly hemispheric sunspot numbers V2.0 (total, north, south, with standard deviations), 1992-01 onward. Columns of the daily file: year;month;day;decimal year;total;north;south;sd total;sd north;sd south;N obs total;N obs north;N obs south;definitive(1)/provisional(0).
